title: Louis Armstrong in Texas, 1931, and the Suburban Gardens
summary: They discuss Armstrong's 1931 tour and trouble at the whites-only Suburban Gardens.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Lee Armstrong in 1931, he was on tour. He played the Suburban Gardens. He came all over. 31, he came through the South. Did you meet him there? No, he was with me in the 30,
I'm at 32 in North Carolina City. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, but that was the same time you played the Suburban Garden. Right, that was.
They had a little trouble in the audience when you played there. Because I recall it really well.
Yeah. The Suburban Garden was an exclusive white place. And there was some trouble there, if I recall, about Larry playing there. Frank asked you some questions, too.
